description: Send a reply in a conversation, or add an internal note. type 'outbound' (default) emails the subscriber and requires bodyText or bodyHtml; type 'note' adds a private team-only note. When the conversation has a recipientAddress (the inbox address it was sent to), list the sender profiles first and, if one's email equals that address, reply from it with senderProfileId. Replying to a closed conversation reopens it. Each successful outbound call sends another email, so after a timeout check the conversation with get_conversation before retrying.

attachments.description: Optional files to attach (max 10, 15 MB total). Requires attachment storage; see attachmentsAvailable from get_inbox_address.

contentType.description: Optional MIME type. Inferred from the file name when omitted.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

senderProfileId.description: Optional sender profile to reply from (outbound only; its domain must be verified). Get IDs from list_sender_profiles. Omit to send from the API key owner's email address.

subject.description: Optional subject override. Defaults to the conversation subject.

type.description: Message type: outbound emails the subscriber, note is internal-only. Defaults to outbound.

name: reply_to_conversation

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `reply_to_conversation` MCP tool.

conversation.description: The inbox conversation record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: The conversation message record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
